title: MI-24 decision record, draft reference schema 0.1.0-draft (not adopted by FINOS)
description: A DRAFT offered for the follow-up to MI-24 (Human-in-the-Loop Action Approval Gate) in finos/ai-governance-framework. FINOS owns the decision record and has neither adopted nor reviewed this schema. It encodes the members that MI-24's Machine-Readable Decision Record Schema bullet lists (pull request 412, head 490d0fd7) and nothing more: where MI-24 states no value set, a member is a non-empty string. MI-24 lists what a record captures at minimum, so other members are allowed, among them the receipt's own payload members when the record travels as the signed payload of a draft-farley-acta-signed-receipts receipt. The rules that relate a record to this file's bytes, to the resolved action, or one member to another cannot be written in JSON Schema; run.mjs beside this file checks them.

timestamp_utc.description: An RFC 3339 date-time whose offset is UTC: Z, z, +00:00 or -00:00. MI-24 names the member; RFC 3339 is this draft's reading. The pattern does not check that the day exists in its month.

autonomy_tier.description: The autonomy tier, or the gating mode: MI-24 writes autonomy_tier (or gating mode). MI-24 names no tiers or modes, so any non-empty string.

resolved_action_digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes of the resolved action, as MI-24 Checkable Decision Records says, written as sha256: and lowercase hex. MI-24 states the preimage, not the encoding.

blast_radius_usd.description: The single-action blast-radius metric, in US dollars. MI-24 states no range, precision or JSON type.

cumulative_24h_usd.description: The rolling 24-hour blast-radius metric, in US dollars. MI-24 states no range, precision or JSON type, and does not say whether it includes this action.

evidence_refs.description: MI-24 writes evidence_refs[]. It states no format for a reference and no minimum count.

principal_id.description: The authenticated principal who decided. That it was authenticated cannot be read from the record.

oversight_pattern.description: MI-24 describes user confirmation, maker-checker or four-eyes, and dual authorization or two-person control (Key Principles), and N-of-M and sequential multi-tier patterns (Routing to the Right Human), but defines no values for this member.

grant_id.description: The standing approval the release relied on, or null for a per-action decision. MI-24 lists the member but does not say what a per-action decision records in it; null is this draft's reading.

human_approver.description: MI-24 writes human_approver (principal_id, oversight_pattern, grant_id). One object names one principal; MI-24 does not say how a record names the two approvers of dual authorization.

suspension_trigger_state.description: For a trip or reset record, MI-24 has it name the trigger (ST-01 to ST-05) and the evidence that tripped it. MI-24 defines no values or members for it, so a non-empty string or an object with at least one member.

idempotency_key.description: MI-24 asks for an idempotency or rollback_token and names only rollback_token; this member is named after its idempotency key. A record carries at least one of the two.

rollback_token.description: A record carries this, idempotency_key, or both.

schema_version.description: The version of the schema the record names. MI-24 requires a record to name its schema by version, but names no member for it.

schema_digest.description: SHA-256 of this file's exact bytes, as sha256: and lowercase hex: the bytes, not their RFC 8785 form. MI-24 names no member for it. A schema cannot state its own digest, so run.mjs checks the value.
